segments.say: This is officially the worst opening in chess. And the best players in the world have played it.
segments.caption: Worst opening ever?

segments.say: King pawn. Black answers. And then... king to e2.
segments.caption: King... forward?!

segments.say: It's called the Bongcloud. It blocks your bishop, blocks your queen, and gives up castling. Every coach on earth says never do this.
segments.caption: Breaks every rule

segments.say: But it gets better. Black copies it.
segments.caption: Double Bongcloud!

segments.say: Two top grandmasters once played this exact thing in an official online event, and it ended in a draw.
segments.caption: Real pros did this

segments.say: Would you ever play the Bongcloud? Comment below, and follow for more chess chaos.
segments.caption: Would YOU play it?
